json_proto.name: VIBRATION_MANAGEMENT
json_proto.semanticDescription: Predictive Maintenance & OEE Command Center semantic model for a multi-plant vibration management system. Covers equipment health monitoring (bearing health scores, ISO 10816 vibration severity, ADR risk classification), OEE metrics (Availability, Performance, Quality), maintenance ticket lifecycle (MTTR, SLA compliance), vibration alerts, and cross-plant executive dashboards. Equipment types include Motors, Compressors, Blowers, Pumps, and Fans across 3 chemical/polymer/pharma plants. Uses process-industry naming conventions (MTR 510 A, COMP 520 C, etc.).

queries.sqlText: SELECT PLANT_NAME, TOTAL_ASSETS, AVG_HEALTH_SCORE, AVG_OEE_30D, OPEN_TICKETS, ACTIVE_ALERTS FROM PREDICTIVE_MAINTENANCE.ANALYTICS.DT_PLANT_DASHBOARD ORDER BY AVG_HEALTH_SCORE
queries.correspondingQuestion: Give me an overview of all plants

queries.sqlText: SELECT ASSET_NAME, PLANT_NAME, BEARING_HEALTH_SCORE, ADR_RISK, PEAK_VEL_RMS, MAX_TEMPERATURE_C FROM PREDICTIVE_MAINTENANCE.CURATED.DT_BEARING_HEALTH WHERE ADR_RISK != 'LOW_RISK' ORDER BY BEARING_HEALTH_SCORE
SELECT ASSET_NAME, PLANT_NAME, ALERT_SEVERITY, RECOMMENDED_ACTION, BEARING_HEALTH_SCORE FROM PREDICTIVE_MAINTENANCE.ANALYTICS.DT_VIBRATION_ALERTS WHERE IS_ACTIONABLE = TRUE ORDER BY ALERT_SEVERITY
queries.correspondingQuestion: Show me all active vibration alerts

queries.sqlText: SELECT PLANT_NAME, PRODUCTION_LINE, AVG(OEE) AS AVG_OEE, AVG(AVAILABILITY) AS AVG_AVAIL, AVG(PERFORMANCE) AS AVG_PERF, AVG(QUALITY) AS AVG_QUAL FROM PREDICTIVE_MAINTENANCE.ANALYTICS.DT_OEE_METRICS WHERE RUN_DATE >= DATEADD('day', -30, CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY PLANT_NAME, PRODUCTION_LINE ORDER BY AVG_OEE
queries.correspondingQuestion: What is the OEE by plant and production line for the last 30 days?

queries.sqlText: SELECT TICKET_ID, ASSET_NAME, PLANT_NAME, SEVERITY, STATUS, ISSUE_OPEN_DATE, CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS_REC, TICKET_AGE_DAYS FROM PREDICTIVE_MAINTENANCE.CURATED.DT_MAINTENANCE_HISTORY WHERE STATUS != 'CLOSED' ORDER BY SEVERITY DESC, ISSUE_OPEN_DATE
queries.correspondingQuestion: What are the open maintenance tickets?

queries.sqlText: SELECT ASSET_NAME, PLANT_NAME, BEARING_HEALTH_SCORE, PEAK_VEL_RMS, PEAK_RSS_ACCEL, MAX_TEMPERATURE_C, WORST_ISO_ZONE FROM PREDICTIVE_MAINTENANCE.CURATED.DT_BEARING_HEALTH ORDER BY BEARING_HEALTH_SCORE ASC LIMIT 10
queries.correspondingQuestion: Which are the 10 worst health assets?

queries.sqlText: SELECT PLANT_NAME, MONTH, TOTAL_TICKETS, AVG_MTTR_HOURS, TOTAL_DOWNTIME_HOURS, BEARING_DEFECT_COUNT, MISALIGNMENT_COUNT, UNBALANCE_COUNT FROM PREDICTIVE_MAINTENANCE.ANALYTICS.DT_TICKET_ANALYTICS ORDER BY PLANT_NAME, MONTH
queries.correspondingQuestion: Show me the maintenance ticket trend by plant and month

queries.sqlText: SELECT FAILURE_MODE, COUNT(*) AS INCIDENT_COUNT, AVG(MTTR_HOURS) AS AVG_MTTR, SUM(DOWNTIME_HOURS) AS TOTAL_DOWNTIME FROM PREDICTIVE_MAINTENANCE.CURATED.DT_MAINTENANCE_HISTORY WHERE FAILURE_MODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY FAILURE_MODE ORDER BY INCIDENT_COUNT DESC
queries.correspondingQuestion: What are the most common failure modes and their average repair time?
